title: Spatial Transcriptomic Profiling of FAP-Positive Cells in Gastric Cancer and Association with Immunotherapy Efficacy.
publicationName: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
journalName: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
snippet: The spatial heterogeneity of the tumor microenvironment in gastric cancer, particularly in the stromal compartment, remains poorly characterized. Fibroblast activation protein (FAP)-positive cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are known to promote tumor progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic resistance.
